name: glue_data
title: Interpolate with names from a dict

origin.description: Like glue, with values taken from a list or data frame.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Dict of names. Columns may be lists of equal length.

arguments.name: parts
arguments.text: Template strings. Named arguments override x.

origin.details: Names in .x are found before names in .envir. The pieces are recycled to the longest column.
origin.value: A character vector of class glue.
origin.example:
x <- list(Species = c("setosa", "versicolor"), Petal.Length = c(1.4, 4.7))
cat(paste(as.character(glue_data(x, "This {Species} has a petal length of {Petal.Length}")), collapse = "\n"), "\n", sep = "")

translation.description: Like glue. A dict of columns supplies the names, and a dotted column name is one key.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Dict of names. Columns may be lists of equal length.

arguments.name: parts
arguments.text: Template strings. Named arguments override x.

translation.details: Keys in x win over envir. {Petal.Length} returns that column. Lists are recycled to the longest piece.
translation.value: A Glue vector with one string per row.
